answer: Sable Tally Decay: each new identity pays a registration fee that decays only with sustained, verified activity—registration n is priced proportional to n, and inactive identities bleed fee credits each epoch. An attacker flooding identities hits a rising marginal cost curve, not a fixed toll, since bulk registrations buy no decay. A beacon confirms activity; unused identities erode. The tide of new identities raises attacker spend superlinearly while honest single identities amortize their fee over time.
